description: Enforce branch naming (feat/, fix/, chore/, etc.)
code:
#!/bin/bash
ALLOWED="^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|ci|build)/"
BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)
[ -z "$BRANCH" ] && exit 0
echo "Checking branch: $BRANCH"
if echo "$BRANCH" | grep -Eq "$ALLOWED"; then exit 0; fi
echo "Branch must start with: feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, refactor/"
exit 1
